# Document search — design handoff

**Status:** concept, ready to build · **Designer:** Jurian Nijssen · **Date:** 13 Oct 2026
**Demo:** https://juriannijssen.github.io/commitment-crusher/search/ (Relevance) · [bank.html](https://juriannijssen.github.io/commitment-crusher/search/bank.html) · [date.html](https://juriannijssen.github.io/commitment-crusher/search/date.html)
**Source:** `prototype/search/` (pages + `document-search.css`), generated by `prototype/build/build_document_search.py`
**Live page it extends:** `https://watchtower.bank.green/institution/<bank>?q=<term>&group_by=<bank|category|date>`

## In one paragraph

The repository search today only matches document **titles**. This concept adds **text search** (the parsed document body) and changes the results list so people can see *why* a document matched. Compared with the live page, we only extend each row **under its title**: the original title when that is where the term was found, one quote with the term highlighted, and how often it was found. Around that we add: results split into **title matches** and **text matches**, a **Relevance** grouping (default), search across **all versions** of a document, and the **spelling variants** of the term as removable pills. Everything else (bank, category, type, date columns, the versions button, group-by control, filters) stays as it is live.

The demo searches **NZBA** across six banks (Commerzbank, Deutsche Bank, HSBC, Société Générale, CaixaBank, ABN AMRO). All results, titles, quotes and counts are real Watchtower data.

---

## 1. Decisions and why

### Search behaviour (backend)

| # | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | Search both the **title** (`cleaned_title` and original `title`) and the **parsed text**. | Title-only misses most relevant documents; text-only floods the list. Both, shown separately, gives precision first and reach second. |
| S2 | Results come in **two sections: title matches first, then text matches.** No toggle or checkbox. | Title matches are almost always on-topic. People get the precise set at once and the broad set below it, without having to understand a filter. |
| S3 | **Literal search plus query expansion.** Before searching, generate the other ways the term is written and search literally for each: abbreviation ↔ full name (NZBA ↔ Net-Zero Banking Alliance), spelling variants (Net-Zero / Net Zero), American/British spelling (decarbonization / decarbonisation), optionally other languages (climate / Klima / climat). | Pure literal search misses documents that only spell the name out (HSBC's 2024 plans). Semantic (embedding) search finds "closely related but not relevant" documents (GFANZ, net zero in general) and cannot give an honest count. Expansion keeps results exact and countable. |
| S4 | Variants must **mean the same thing**, not something related. Source: a curated list (the glossary) and/or an LLM, generated once per query, not per document. | Keeps the flood out. "Net-Zero Banking Alliance" qualifies for NZBA; "GFANZ" or "net zero" does not. |
| S5 | Every variant is shown as a **removable pill** at the top ("Search: NZBA", "Also: Net-Zero Banking Alliance", …). | People can see why a phrase is highlighted that they did not type, and remove a wrong variant (ambiguous acronyms such as PRB). |
| S6 | **Search every version** of a document; show the document **once**, as its **newest version that contains the term**. | A term can disappear from the latest version (HSBC's Net Zero Transition Plan dropped the NZBA after HSBC left the alliance in July 2025). That is a finding, so the document must still appear. |
| S7 | **Ranking (Relevance):** title matches first; then by how densely the term appears relative to document length, with diminishing returns for repeats (BM25-style); exact-phrase matches above scattered words; optionally a small boost for newer documents. **No score is shown.** | A raw count mostly measures document length (a 300-page report beats a focused 20-page policy). Density reflects what a document is *about*. Scores invite questions they cannot answer. |
| S8 | **Count** = case-insensitive occurrences of the term and all its active variants in the parsed text of that version. | Same rule for every row and version, so numbers compare. |
| S9 | **Quote:** one passage of about 40–45 words around a mention, from running prose (not a table row, heading, or link list), cut at word boundaries, "…" where cut mid-sentence. | One good quote is enough to judge relevance; two added noise. Tables give unreadable quotes. |
| S10 | No page numbers. | The parsed markdown has no page breaks (only a few documents carry `**Page 03**` markers). If page numbers are wanted later, parsing must keep page breaks. |

### Results list (frontend)

| # | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | Section headings: **"{n} documents mention “{term}” in the title"** and **"… in the text"**. No collapse. | The heading carries the count, so no separate total is needed. |
| F2 | **Title match rows:** title (term highlighted), **original title** under it only when the term is in the original title and not in the improved one, then **"Found {n} times"**. No quote. | The title already shows why it matched; a quote would repeat it and make the section long. |
| F3 | **Text match rows:** title, **one quote** (~45 words) with the term highlighted, then **"Found {n} times"**. | The quote is the only evidence of why the document matched. |
| F4 | Row columns stay as live: **icon · bank · category · title block · versions · type · date**. In the Relevance view category is the 2nd text column (after bank). | Keep the live layout; only the title block grows downwards. |
| F5 | **"Show {n} more"** at the end of a list, in the **title column**; n = 20, or fewer when fewer remain; reveals the next results **once** and disappears. | More logical next to the titles; 20 at a time instead of "Show 527 more". |
| F6 | **Group by: Relevance (default) · Bank · Date.** Category is **not** offered while searching. | Relevance keeps the title/text split. Category was tried and dropped: most results land in "Miscellaneous" or tiny groups. |
| F7 | **Tabs** Documents · Updates · Syntheses · My Uploads stay; **no total count** in the tools bar. | The section headings already give the counts. |
| F8 | **Upload Policies** button stays top right of the card header. | Same as live. |

### Versions

| # | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| V1 | The **versions button is always the live versions button** ("{n} versions" / "Hide versions"). No extra badges. | One control, as today. |
| V2 | Opening it lists the **other versions**: **newer versions above** the row, **older versions below**, each with its own result: **"Found {n} times"** or **"Not found in this version"** (coral). | Shows directly in which versions the term appears and where it disappeared. |
| V3 | **Closed by default.** The newer version without the term (coral) only appears once the versions are opened. | The row itself already shows a matching version. |
| V4 | Lines follow **Figma 14037:63501 (Repository/V2 Row Document)**: a document and its versions sit **0px apart**; each version draws its own piece of line inside its own row box: "Version Top" (newer, above: from the middle to the bottom edge), "Version Middle" (edge to edge), "Version Bottom" (last older: top edge to the middle, then turns in). The document's own row ("Version Selected") has no line. | Lines must touch the hover-box edges and connect; nothing floats. |
| V5 | **Every row is its own hover box**, including each version. Version rows also carry the green document icon. | Same behaviour as live rows. |
| V6 | In a version row the quote/count line sits **directly under the version's title**, aligned with it (not at the far left). | Keeps the version readable as one block. |

### Grouping views

| # | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| G1 | **Bank** uses the live `group_by=bank` structure: bank bar → a section per **category** (240px left column: category name, link icon, "({n} documents)"; rows on the right) → rows **without** bank and category columns. Inside a category, **title matches before text matches**. One "Show {n} more" per bank, in the title column. Heading: **"Found documents per bank"**. | Reuse the live structure exactly. |
| G2 | **Date**: one flat list, newest first, no title/text split. Heading: **"Found documents by publication date"**. | Chosen by the designer (simple chronological reading). |

---

## 2. Styling remarks from the designer (verbatim decisions)

- **Highlight (`<mark>`):** background = the yellow of the filter pills (`--bg-button-quote`, #FDE09A), **2px horizontal padding**, **no rounded corners**, **bold** (semibold 600) — also inside quotes.
- **No explanatory line** about how results are sorted ("just confuses").
- Section headings: **padding like the live page (16px 24px)**, **no background band**, a **divider under each heading** and **one above the second heading** as the section break.
- **Original title:** directly under the improved title, **smaller type only** (12px); everything else uses the live sizes.
- **Quote:** one only, about **twice the original snippet length** (~45 words), **no section heading**, **no left border**.
- **No "Show all in document →" link** (nothing to link to yet) and **no page numbers**.
- **Count line:** "Found {n} times" / "Found once"; **12px, regular (not bold), secondary text color** (`--fg-secondary`). "Not found in this version": **same style, coral** (`--coral-600`), **no pill/bubble**.
- Word **"text", never "content"** ("title search" and "text search").
- **"Show {n} more":** the **secondary Medium button** (`Form/Button`, Medium, secondary), **in the title column**, 20 at a time, works **once**.
- **Green document icon** on every row, version rows included.
- **Category** is the 2nd column in the Relevance view.
- **Versions:** 0px between a document and its versions; lines must touch the row box edges (Figma component); each row hovers on its own (never group the hover); newer versions above, older below.
- Bank view: **category styling, link icon and document count as live**; no "In the title / In the text" label column.

---

## 3. Data the frontend needs (suggested API shape)

Per search: the active term and variants, totals, and two ranked lists.

```json
{
  "query": { "term": "NZBA", "variants": ["Net-Zero Banking Alliance", "Net Zero Banking Alliance"] },
  "totals": { "title": 3, "text": 95 },
  "title_matches": [ /* Result, ranked */ ],
  "text_matches":  [ /* Result, ranked, paginated 20 at a time */ ]
}
```

```json
{
  "document_id": 8706,
  "institution": "Société Générale S.A.",
  "category": "PRB Report",
  "type": "PDF",
  "publication_date": "2024-07-31",
  "title": "Progress Report 2024 (Group)",
  "original_title": "NZBA PROGRESS REPORT 2024 (JULY 2024)",
  "show_original_title": true,
  "match_in": "title",
  "mentions": 25,
  "snippet": null,
  "highlights": ["NZBA", "Net-Zero Banking Alliance", "Net Zero Banking Alliance"],
  "versions": [
    { "document_id": 4929, "position": "older", "publication_date": "2024-07-01", "title": "NZBA Progress Report 2024 (Group)", "mentions": 2 },
    { "document_id": 38795, "position": "older", "publication_date": "2023-11-30", "title": "Progress Report 2023 (Group)", "mentions": 3 }
  ]
}
```

Rules:
- `title` = Watchtower `cleaned_title`; `original_title` = Watchtower `title`. `show_original_title` = term/variant found in `original_title` **and not** in `title`.
- `match_in` = `"title"` when the term/variant is in either title, else `"text"`.
- `snippet` only for `match_in = "text"` (≈45 words, see S9). Frontend highlights every term/variant in titles, original title and snippet (case-insensitive).
- The result row is the **newest version containing the term**; `versions` lists all other versions with `position` (`newer` → rendered above, `older` → below) and their own `mentions` (0 → "Not found in this version"). Version chains come from `previous_document_version`.
- Totals per bank are needed for the Bank view's "Show {n} more"; per-category counts in the Bank view are counts of the documents shown.

## 4. Design tokens and type styles

Names are the prototype's tokens (`prototype/styles.css`, mirrored from Figma "bank.green Design System"). Live Watchtower uses the same palette as Tailwind classes (`sky-*`, `ocean-*`, `sushi-*`).

| Use | Token | Value | Live (Tailwind) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Highlight background | `--bg-button-quote` (sunglow-300) | #FDE09A | same as the filter pill |
| Filter pill text | `--fg-button-quote` (sunglow-900) | #644601 | |
| Title link | `--fg-link` (ocean-600) | #2563EB | `text-ocean-600` |
| Version title (grey) | `--sky-500` | #56668F | `text-sky-500` |
| Count line / original title | `--fg-secondary` (sky-500) | #56668F | `text-sky-500` |
| "Not found in this version" | `--coral-600` | #E84C50 | `text-coral-600` (add if missing) |
| Body / quote text | `--fg-primary` (gray-800) | #292D30 | `text-primary-foreground` |
| Row hover, group bar | `--sky-50` | #F4F8FD | `bg-sky-50` |
| Dividers | `--stroke-border` (sky-100) | #D9E0F2 | `border-sky-100` |
| Tree line, versions button border | `--sky-200` | #B2C1E5 | `border-sky-200` |
| Type label (PDF), link icon | `--fg-label-secondary` / `--sky-300` | #8296C9 | `text-sky-300` |
| Category count "(n documents)" | `--sky-400` | #6A7DAF | `text-sky-400` |
| Group bar text | `--sky-600` | #434F6D | `text-sky-600` |
| Category name | `--sky-900` | #151923 | `text-sky-900` |
| Document icon | `--sushi-500` | #7BB123 | `text-sushi-500` (`ic:outline-article`) |
| Secondary button | `--bg-button-secondary` / `--fg-button-secondary` / hover `--fg-button-secondary-hover` / `--stroke-button-secondary` | #FFF / #56668F / #434F6D / #C2CDEA | |
| Primary button (Upload) | `--bg-button-primary` / hover `--bg-button-primary-hover` | #7BB123 / #5E892A | |

| Class | Figma style | Size / weight | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ts-title-sm` | title/small | Poppins 24/32 semibold | "Repository" |
| `ts-body-md-bold` | body/medium_bold | 16/24 semibold | section headings |
| `ts-body-sm-bold` | body/small_bold | 14/20 semibold | titles, pills, group bar, category name |
| `ts-body-sm` | body/small | 14/20 regular | bank, category, quote, date, tabs |
| `ts-body-xs` | body/extra_small | 12/16 regular | original title, "Found n times", category count |
| `ts-label-md` | label/medium | 12/16 semibold uppercase | PDF / HTML |
| `ts-label-sm` | label/small | 10/12 semibold uppercase | versions button, group-by |
| `ts-button-sm` | body/button_small | 14/20 medium | Show more, Upload Policies |

**Buttons.** "Show {n} more" = `Form/Button`, Medium, secondary: 40px high, padding 9px 11px (10×12 minus the 1px stroke), radius 8px, 1px `--stroke-button-secondary`, white, text `--fg-button-secondary`. Versions button = `Repository/Button/Versions`: 20px high, padding 0 6px, radius 6px, 1px sky-200, white, 10px uppercase sky-500, `material-symbols:expand-all` / `collapse-all` icon 14px.

**Spacing.** Rows: 8px padding, 6px radius, 8px between documents, **0px between a document and its versions**, 12px column gap. Lists inset 16px from the card. Section heading 16px 24px. Bank category label column 240px, padding 20px 24px. Tree line: 1px sky-200 at x = 8px inside a 28px tree column; the horizontal stub is 10px long at the middle of the first text line (y = 10px).

## 5. What is new or different from live — small snippets

Only the parts that change. Everything not listed here (rows, columns, filters, pills, tabs, group-by, versions button, bank bar, fonts, colours) **stays exactly as live**. Class names below are the prototype's; map them to the live components. Colours are given as tokens with the live Tailwind name.

### 5.1 Highlight in titles and quotes — **new**

```html
<a class="title">Sectoral Decarbonisation Targets 2024 (Group)</a>
<p class="quote">…Deutsche Bank joined the <mark>Net Zero Banking Alliance</mark> (<mark>NZBA</mark>) as a founder member…</p>
```
```css
mark {
  background: #FDE09A;   /* --bg-button-quote: the filter pill yellow */
  color: inherit;        /* keeps the link blue in titles */
  font-weight: 600;      /* bold, also inside quotes */
  padding: 0 2px;        /* horizontal only */
  border-radius: 0;      /* no rounding */
}
```

### 5.2 Title block grows downwards — **changed** (the only change to the row)

Live: one line (title only, row 32px high, `items-center`). Now: title, then optional original title, quote and count; the row grows and every cell aligns to the **top**.

```html
<div class="title-block">                       <!-- the live title cell -->
  <a class="title">Progress Report 2024 (Group)</a>
  <p class="original-title">Original title: <mark>NZBA</mark> PROGRESS REPORT 2024 (JULY 2024)</p>  <!-- only when the term is only in the original title -->
  <p class="quote">…one passage of ~45 words…</p>  <!-- text matches only -->
  <p class="found">Found 25 times</p>               <!-- always; "Found once" for 1 -->
</div>
```
```css
.row { align-items: start; height: auto; padding: 8px; }   /* live: items-center, min-h-8 */
.title-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.title { white-space: normal; }                             /* live truncates to one line */
.original-title { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: #56668F; margin-top: -4px; }  /* typo-body-extra-small text-sky-500 */
.quote { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: #292D30; }                              /* typo-body-small, primary text */
.found { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: #56668F; }             /* typo-body-extra-small text-sky-500, not bold */
```

### 5.3 Section headings in the Relevance view — **new**

```html
<div class="section-head"><h3>3 documents mention “NZBA” in the title</h3></div>
…
<div class="section-head"><h3>95 documents mention “NZBA” in the text</h3></div>
```
```css
.section-head { padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #D9E0F2; }  /* no background band */
.group + .group .section-head { border-top: 1px solid #D9E0F2; }  /* rule above the 2nd heading */
.section-head h3 { font: 600 16px/24px Inter; }                          /* typo-body-medium-bold */
```

### 5.4 Group-by: Relevance added, Category hidden while searching — **changed**

```html
<span>Group by:</span> [Relevance*] [Bank] [Date]
```
Headings of the other views: "Found documents per bank", "Found documents by publication date" (live: "Selected documents …").

### 5.5 Search pills for variants — **new pills, existing pill style**

```html
<button class="pill">Search: NZBA <span>×</span></button>
<button class="pill">Also: Net-Zero Banking Alliance <span>×</span></button>
<button class="pill">Also: Net Zero Banking Alliance <span>×</span></button>
```
Same component as the live filter pills; one per variant, each removable.

### 5.6 Versions — **changed behaviour, same button**

The live "N versions" button stays. What changes when it is open:
- the row shows the **newest version that contains the term**;
- **newer** versions are listed **above** the row, **older** below;
- each version row shows **"Found N times"** or **"Not found in this version"**;
- a document and its versions sit **0px apart**; each row is its own hover box; version rows keep the green icon and the grey title (as live).

```html
<div class="version-row is-newer">  <!-- above the document row -->
  …<span class="tree"></span> HSBC Holdings plc … <a class="title version">Net Zero Transition Plan 2025 (Holdings)</a>
  <p class="found not-found">Not found in this version</p>
</div>
<div class="row">… the document (newest version with the term) …</div>
<div class="version-row is-older">…<p class="found">Found once</p></div>
```
```css
.not-found { color: #E84C50; }   /* --coral-600; same size and weight as .found, plain text, no pill */
.version-group > * + * { margin-top: 0; }   /* 0px between a document and its versions (8px between documents stays) */
```

Tree lines (Figma **14037:63501**, Repository/V2 Row Document). 1px `#B2C1E5` (sky-200), at x = 8px in a 28px tree column; the stub is 10px wide at the middle of the first text line. Each row draws its own piece, edge to edge of its own box, so the pieces join:

| Row | Variant | Line |
|---|---|---|
| Newer version (above) | Version Top | middle → bottom edge |
| Document | Version Selected | none |
| Older version, more below | Version Middle | top edge → bottom edge |
| Last older version | Version Bottom | top edge → middle, then the stub |

Watch out: if the first cell clips text (`overflow: hidden` for the ellipsis), it also clips the line; clip only the name, not the cell.

In views without a bank/category cell (Bank view) the tree sits in front of the whole title block, so the title, quote and count stay aligned.

### 5.7 "Show N more" — **new**

```html
<div class="more" style="grid-template-columns: <same columns as the rows>">
  <button class="btn-secondary-medium" style="grid-column: <title column>">Show 20 more</button>
</div>
```
`Form/Button`, Medium, secondary (40px, 9px 11px, radius 8, 1px #C2CDEA, white, 14/20 medium #56668F, hover #434F6D). Sits in the **title column**. 20 at a time, or what is left when fewer; one per list (Relevance: per section; Bank: per bank; Date: one).

### 5.8 Bank view — **live structure, rows trimmed**

Live `group_by=bank` exactly: bank bar → category section (240px label column: name, link icon, "(n documents)") → rows. Differences only: rows show **icon · title block · versions · type · date** (no bank or category column, the bar and label already say it), and **title matches come before text matches** inside a category.

### 5.9 Tools bar — **changed**

No total count (the section headings carry the counts). Tabs Documents · Updates · Syntheses · My Uploads and the Upload Policies button as live.

---

## 6. Behaviour

- **Versions button:** toggles the version rows of that document; label "N versions" ⇄ "Hide versions"; closed by default.
- **Show N more:** loads the next 20 into the same list and goes away when nothing is left. (The demo reveals pre-rendered rows once.)
- **Variant pill ×:** re-runs the search without that variant.
- **Category link icon (Bank view):** copies a link to that section, as live.

---

## 7. Not in the demo / open

- Live pagination, loading states and empty states ("No documents mention …").
- How variants are generated (glossary list vs LLM) and how a user adds one.
- Page numbers (needs page breaks kept during parsing).
- True per-category totals in the Bank view.
- The Date view shows title and text matches mixed; confirm that is wanted.
- Phone layout: the list scrolls sideways below 780px, as the live table does.
